title: Aon nears around $17B deal to buy KKR-backed USI Insurance – WSJ
title_zh: Aon 接近以 17B 美元收购 KKR 支持的 USI Insurance – 华尔街日报
summary: Investing.com -- Aon is close to signing a deal with private equity firm KKR to buy Valhalla, NY-based insurance brokerage USI Insurance for around $17 billion including debt, according to a report from the Wall Street Journal on Sunday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据《华尔街日报》周日报道，怡安即将与私募股权公司 KKR 签署协议，以约 170 亿美元（含债务）收购总部位于纽约瓦尔哈拉的保险经纪公司 USI Insurance。

title: Aon Nears Roughly $17 Billion Deal for Insurance Brokerage USI
title_zh: Aon 即将以约 170 亿美元收购保险经纪 USI
summary: Aon  is near an agreement to buy insurance brokerage USI Insurance from private-equity firm  KKR  for roughly $17 billion, including debt, according to people familiar with the matter. USI, based in Valhalla, N.Y., is an insurance brokerage and consulting firm.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，怡安集团即将达成协议，以约 170 亿美元（含债务）从私募股权公司 KKR 手中收购保险经纪公司 USI Insurance。 USI 总部位于纽约州瓦尔哈拉，是一家保险经纪和咨询公司。

title: Is a Stock Market Crash Imminent Under President Donald Trump? More Than 85 Years of Historical Precedent Offers an Answer.
title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的股市崩盘是否迫在眉睫？超过 85 年的历史先例提供了答案。
summary: One scenario makes stock market crashes likelier, and Trump is overseeing it right now.
summary_zh: 一种情况使得股市崩盘的可能性更大，而特朗普现在正在监督这种情况。

title: Chevron's Microsoft Data Center Deal Was a Bigger Story Than Its Earnings. Here's Why.
title_zh: 雪佛龙与微软数据中心的交易比其收益更重要。这就是为什么。
summary: Chevron is getting in on the AI boom with its recent long-term energy agreement with Microsoft.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙最近与微软签署了长期能源协议，加入了人工智能热潮。

title: Nobody's Talking About This Energy Company, but It's Quietly Signing the Power Deals Feeding the AI Build-Out
title_zh: 没有人谈论这家能源公司，但它正在悄悄签署电力协议，为人工智能的发展提供动力
summary: Clearway Energy is emerging as a key player in AI power.
summary_zh: Clearway Energy 正在成为人工智能领域的关键参与者。
